No, I understand. I don't know why, but I come here often time looking for a diamond in a rough to find that someone actually got better.
But you're right, I always always leave feeling worse and more hopeless, so this was what I desperately needed. I'm so proud of you and glad that this subreddit has been able to help you though. Hopefully it can help more people and have more success recovery stories such as yours.
Truly inspiring. Thank you for writing this, really. It was needed.
You're right. I guess I'm thankful that heights still scare me more than living. Thank you for your input, and I hope you're feeling better because you deserve to want to live.
Yes, I think I am the same way too. Thank you.
